title: 第19章 带上大花勇闯天涯第20章 还真是单纯可爱没被社会毒打过
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
青鸳是元神故意散发出化神气息，这要是周围有一个元婴高阶的妖兽，就这一会的时间，青鸳整个肉身就没了，元神能不能保全都是两说。
青瑶快到近前时，那些蠢蠢欲动的妖兽感觉到又有化神气息到了，当下四散奔逃。
青瑶到了近前，看到青鸳昏迷，当即掏出一枚疗伤圣药，塞入其口中，并开始运动助其炼化，只消一会，青鸳看到了青瑶，就以为这个陷阱是一定是姜云天弄的，青瑶必然知情。
青鸳开口骂道“小浪蹄子，你们俩个干的好事，差点要了我的命。”
青瑶也是一脸懵。
但也没有开口反驳。
她也不知道发生了什么，万一是姜云天搞出来的，至少姨母也骂对了一半。
况且她说她不知情，倒是对方得信才行啊。
她就是默默帮青鸳疗伤。
青鸳伤势缓解了，但全身骨头碎裂，一时半会站不起来，看青瑶也不做声，也不好再训斥她。
仔细一感知，才发觉有七道元神正向她们之处飞来。
青瑶看到那七个元神，也顿时知道发生了什么事，里面一定出了大变故，要不然不会都舍弃肉身，元神逃出。
到了近前，七个元神看到青瑶也是松了一口气，有一个元婴巅峰在，大家也就不那么怕了，在她们的认知里，这血兽谷里的化神妖兽已经自爆。
压根没有想到会是被算计的。
林仙儿说道“蛮牛长老呢？”
青瑶道“”
我没看到，感觉有个人影向那边飞去，我先找到青鸳长老，就先对她施救了。”
林仙儿道“走，一起救了蛮牛长老，然后回宗。”
青瑶起身，给青鸳又喂了一颗圣级疗伤丹，背起青鸳，带领着大家开始向那个人影飞走的方向飞行。
在内圈中，赤狐一族在赤嫣与赤媚带着赤火回族后，立即集合部众宣布了成为虎王的亲信的事，对被种下魂奴印之事也没有遮掩，族人也是一片欢腾，能成为被虎王的亲信，被种魂奴印，那是一种荣耀，赤狐一族被欺负和嫌弃了百万年了，这下终于被虎王大人提携，这是全族荣耀啊。

正当大家欢歌畅饮之际，响得一巨响，从核心区传出。
赤嫣和赤媚领先飞出，刚出洞府，只见从核心区那边一个人影飞了过来，从眼前飞过，向更远处飞去。
赤嫣对族人说道，都在此处等待，守好族众。
几位长老也是点了点头。
媚儿，你跟我过去。
说罢率先向人影飞落的地方飞去。
赤媚也是紧随其后。
不一会两人看到一个身材高大的人躺在地上，一看就是凤仙宗的服饰。
救还是不救，这是个问题，难住了赤嫣，但赤嫣转念一想，这些人是在核心区被冲击到此处，说明是与虎大人在战斗，刚才那声巨响不会又有人自爆了吗，不会是虎大人吧，不对，要是虎大人，自己的魂奴印会瞬间要了自己的命。
想到此，他们判断此人是敌非友，先拿下。
正思考间，只见那躺在地上之人，全身骨碎完全身都是肉泥一般，他神元飞出，看到赤嫣更是急速逃跑，赤嫣一见，当下手一挥，一个幻阵把神元笼罩，神元一阵恍惚，紧接着，赤媚扔出拘魂索，神元被捆住，拉到了二人近前。
赤嫣在犹豫了一下后，一出手，抹去了神识，将纯静的神元交给赤媚道：“你回去把它炼化，定可晋阶化神，等我把虎王大人赠的兽丹和公子赠的凝神丹都炼化必定晋级化神，本来那些赠给我二人的兽丹和凝神丹，应该够我二人勉强晋阶化神，现在有了这个纯静神元，我赤狐一族即将有两位化神，又得虎王大人青睐，我族必定飞黄腾达”
说完正要把那化神大能的身体也带走，但看到远处已有妖兽向这边赶来，就放弃尸身，两人果断离开。
那些汇集而来的妖兽，一起就开始围攻这具尸身，不一会尸体就被分食，天灵盖都被打开，吸食干净，等到青瑶等人赶到时，妖兽早已望风而逃，看到这血腥一幕，也是一阵唏嘘，修行万年的化神，被一群妖兽以这种方式啃食。
让人不寒而栗。
林仙儿道，“但愿神元已经离开”
众人听了也是默不作声。
大家都知道，蛮牛凶多吉少了，蛮牛是他们之中神魂力最差的，因为体魄强健，在神魂修炼方面擅长。
所在神魂偏弱。
大家更愿意相信，他在一瞬间被震散了神元，才会在冲击下无法控制自己飞到这么远的地方，毕竟大家都在第一瞬间，神魂震荡，不能自持。

大家在青瑶的带领与保护下，向外围而去，此时的青鸳也可以自由行动了，在远离谷口的外围偏僻之处，停了下来，外围的紊乱气息已经很轻微了。
content_en:
Qingyuan's Yuanshen deliberately exudes the aura of becoming a god. If there is a high-level Nascent Soul monster around, Qingyuan's entire physical body will be gone in just a moment, and it is unclear whether the Yuanshen can be saved.
When Qing Yao was approaching, the demonic beasts that were ready to move felt the aura of becoming gods coming again, and they immediately fled in all directions.
Qing Yao came closer and saw Qing Yuan unconscious, so he immediately took out a healing holy medicine, stuffed it into his mouth, and started to exercise to help him refine it. After a while, Qing Yuan saw Qing Yao and thought that Jiang Yuntian must have set up this trap, and Qing Yao must know about it.
Qingyuan cursed, "Xiaolang Hoozi, the good thing you two did almost killed me."
Qingyao was also confused.
But he didn't open his mouth to refute.
She didn't know what happened. If it was Jiang Yuntian who did it, at least her aunt was half right.
Besides, she said she didn't know anything, but the other party had to believe her.
She just silently helped Qingyuan heal his injuries.
Qingyuan's injuries were relieved, but the bones all over his body were broken and he would not be able to stand up for a while. Seeing Qingyao being silent, it was difficult to reprimand her.
After careful sensing, they realized that seven souls were flying towards them.
Qingyao saw the seven souls and immediately knew what had happened. There must have been a big change inside, otherwise they wouldn't have abandoned their bodies and the souls could have escaped.
When they got closer, the seven souls breathed a sigh of relief when they saw Qingyao. With a peak Nascent Soul here, everyone was not so afraid. In their knowledge, the god-transforming monster in the Blood Beast Valley had already self-destructed.
I never thought that I would be plotted against.
Lin Xian'er said, "Where is Elder Manniu?"
Qingyao said ""
I didn't see it, but I felt a figure flying over there. I found Elder Qingyuan first and rescued her first. "
Lin Xianer said, "Let's save Elder Manniu together, and then return to the sect. "
Qing Yao stood up, fed Qing Yuan another holy healing pill, carried Qing Yuan on his back, and led everyone to start flying in the direction where the figure flew away.
In the inner circle, after Chi Yan and Chi Mei returned to the clan with Chi Huo, the Red Fox clan immediately gathered their tribe and announced that they would become the Tiger King's confidants. They did not hide the fact that they were given the Soul Slave Seal. The clan members were also in joy. It was an honor to be the Tiger King's confidant and to be given the Soul Slave Seal. It was an honor. The Red Fox clan had been bullied and disliked for a million years, and now they were finally promoted by the Tiger King. This was an honor for the whole clan.
While everyone was singing and drinking, a loud noise came from the core area.
Chi Yan and Chi Mei flew out first. As soon as they left the cave, they saw a figure flying over from the core area, flying past their eyes and flying farther away.
Chi Yan said to the clan members, everyone is waiting here to protect the clan members.
Several elders also nodded.
Meier, come with me.
After that, he took the lead and flew towards the place where the figure landed.
Chi Mei followed closely behind.
After a while, the two of them saw a tall man lying on the ground. At first glance, he was wearing the clothes of Fengxian Sect.
To save or not to save, this is the question, which stumped Chi Yan, but Chi Yan then thought about it, these people were attacked here in the core area, which means they were fighting Master Tiger. Couldn't someone have self-destructed with the loud noise just now? It couldn't be Master Tiger, no, if it were Master Tiger, his soul slave mark would kill him instantly.
Thinking of this, they judged that this person was an enemy rather than a friend, and captured him first.
While he was thinking, he saw the man lying on the ground, his whole body was broken into pieces and was covered with flesh. His divine energy flew out, and he ran away quickly when he saw Chi Yan. When Chi Yan saw it, he waved his hand and an illusory array enveloped his divine energy. The divine energy was in a trance. Then, Chi Mei threw out the soul-binding rope, and the divine energy was tied up and pulled in front of the two of them.
After Chi Yan hesitated for a moment, she made a move and wiped out her consciousness, handed the pure divine essence to Chi Mei and said: "You go back and refine it, you will definitely be able to advance to the level of divine transformation. When I get the beast elixir given by Lord Tiger King and the concentration elixir given by the young master.Refining will definitely lead to the promotion of God Transformation. Originally, the Beast Pills and Concentration Pills given to the two of us should be enough for the two of us to barely advance to the level of God Transformation. Now with this Pure Jing Shen Yuan, our Red Fox clan will soon have two God Transformations, and with the favor of Lord Tiger King, our clan will definitely flourish."
After saying that, they were about to take away the body of the powerful god-transformer, but when they saw a monster coming towards them in the distance, they gave up on the body and left decisively.
The monster beasts that gathered together began to besiege the corpse. After a while, the corpse was devoured, and the Tianling Cap was opened and sucked clean. By the time Qing Yao and others arrived, the monster beasts had already fled. Seeing this bloody scene, they also sighed. The transformation god who had practiced for thousands of years was eaten by a group of monster beasts in this way.
It's chilling.
Lin Xian'er said, "I hope Shenyuan has left."
Everyone was silent after hearing this.
Everyone knows that Man Niu is in trouble. Man Niu has the weakest soul power among them because he is physically strong and good at soul cultivation.
The soul is weak.
Everyone is more willing to believe that he was shaken away in an instant and was unable to control himself to fly so far under the impact. After all, everyone was shaken in the first moment and could not control themselves.
Under the leadership and protection of Qing Yao, everyone headed towards the outside. At this time, Qing Yuan could move freely. He stopped at a remote place far away from the entrance of the valley. The chaotic atmosphere in the outside was already very slight.
